_comment: Tier -> ordered [provider, model] candidates for src/inference/router.py. SELF-HOSTED ONLY: her reasoning runs on weights this machine holds (decision 1, docs/ARIA_NEXT_SESSION.md). Vendor candidates listed here are refused by src/inference/policy.py before the router calls them, so adding one back here does nothing on its own — the override is the ARIA_ALLOW_VENDOR_BRAIN environment variable, and it is the owner's to set.
_degrade: The second candidate in a tier only ever answers under ARIA_DEGRADE=disclose, and then the reply is tagged degraded. By default she abstains rather than answering from the smaller model in the same voice (decision 4).
_models: qwen2.5-coder:7b and gemma3:4b are what is installed today. The brief recommends a general instruct model (qwen2.5:7b-instruct) over the coder tune for analyst prose - scripts/brain_preflight.py checks what is present and prints the pull command. Nothing here downloads anything.
